title: Perseus
summary: Raleigh names Perseus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Perseus, sonne of Iupiter and Danae, in Ehuds or Deborahs dayes; his Souldiers slew Medusa, and he slew Acrisius. He is not Perseus father of Erythraeus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. II, sig. 264b–265a
